messages:
alex_kaplan: Quick handoff — I'm handing oncall to @maya in ~10m. Planned deploy tonight at 03:00 UTC (v2.7.1). Low overall risk but note: one online DB migration + a feature-flag flip for routing. Leaving watchers: @maya, @devon_ops, @sara_mm. deploy-bot will post progress.

maya: I'll take it. Quick Qs: exact migration steps and any expected service disruption?

alex_kaplan: Migration is add-column only, backfill runs async. No downtime expected. Steps: 1) kick off migration job; 2) confirm new column exists; 3) start backfill in safe batch size. If backfill impacts p95 queries, pause the backfill job. Backfill job name: backfill-new-route (Airflow).

devon_ops: Got it — I'll watch DB metrics. I'll add a temporary alert for p95 > 500ms and will pause backfill if triggered. :thumbsup:

sara_mm: Where's the feature flag and exact key?

alex_kaplan: Flag is routing_v2_rollout, toggle via internal console or API. Example curl to flip it on:

```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/flags/routing_v2_rollout -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"state":"on"}'
```

maya: Thanks. Plan from my side: I'll start watch now. Smoke tests at +5m after canary -> check health endpoints, token quota usage, and run a small synthetic load against /v1/generate. If >5% request failures or big latency spike we roll back the flag. Rollout watchers: @ryan (observability), @devon_ops (DB), @sara_mm (routing).

ryan: I'll monitor dashboards and add an alert for 5xx rate > 1% and a token-latency spike. Will also watch the token-level cost/latency breakdown in the console.

deploy-bot: deploy started: v2.7.1 canary -> 3 nodes (canary IDs: canary-17..19)

alex_kaplan: Canary plan: 10m canary, if healthy -> 25% for 15m -> 100%. Known risk: under GPU memory pressure we may hit model-variant fallback to model-v2-q (quantized). Fallback reduces mem and may change quality slightly. Keep an eye on qa-prompt-regression scoreboard and the fallback events stream.

maya: Where's the runbook? Can you drop the link and the rollback steps?

alex_kaplan: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-v2.7.1. Short rollback notes: either trigger deploy-bot rollback to previous revision or flip routing_v2_rollout to off; recovery steps are in the runbook. Paging: oncall@redwood.io (use pager if high-sev).

devon_ops: For DB rollback: none expected for add-column; if backfill causes perf regression we just pause it and let service stabilize. I'll be ready to revert any infra scaling changes if needed.

ryan: I'll post a short canary status at +10m and again after full rollout.

maya: Taking over now — thanks for the notes @alex_kaplan. I'll ping here for canary summary and any anomalies. If you need me urgently page me or call out in #eng-oncall. :eyes:
